goal: Remove every Windows user-facing file, configuration, theme, local-backup and canvas export surface while preserving internal thumbnail, print and recovery primitives.
non_goals: Do not delete internal serializers or renderers still used by thumbnails, print viewers or recovery snapshots.
Do not replace export actions with download or share aliases.
Do not implement credential migration, recovery storage or release packaging from Tasks 19-21.
Do not remove remote synchronization import/download capabilities that are not local user-facing export surfaces.
acceptance_criteria: Windows-rendered menus, buttons and actions expose no Markdown, HTML, JSON, PDF, configuration, theme-code, local-backup, PNG or SVG export.
Internal thumbnail rendering, existing viewer print support and recovery snapshot writers remain available only through non-user-facing paths.
Removed surfaces leave no dead imports, handlers, state or misleading aliases.
Focused export-boundary tests, TypeScript, production build, independent review and exhaustive L2 impact pass.
notes: Use test-first implementation and keep routine audit reporting concise.
Use a leaf internal export data-contract slice for L2; all user-facing component context_sources remain mandatory manual context.
The contract is based on Windows UI reachability, not a repository-wide ban on the export symbol name.
Use fixed UTF-8 I/O for Chinese UI copy and non-ASCII source.
